title: shadcn theme preset
description: One canonical preset: lib/registry_next/themes/<id>.json. Supersedes the schemaVersion 1 files in lib/registry/themes_preset/. Design rules: (1) key names are the camelCase of the shadcn CSS variable, no renames (REARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md 6.1); (2) all 32 colour tokens are required in BOTH light and dark - nothing is derived; (3) colours carry an optional alpha channel and it is never flattened; (4) fonts are mode-independent, so they live in one top-level block; (5) radius/spacing/tracking are mode-independent because no preset differs between the two modes; (6) only the six base shadow atoms are stored per mode - the eight derived sizes (shadow2xs..shadow2xl) are ALWAYS recomputed at build time by ShadowScale.derive, never stored, because storing them was the bug this schema removes.

$schema.description: Optional relative pointer to this schema.

id.description: File name without the .json suffix, e.g. amber-minimal.

name.description: Human readable preset name, e.g. Amber Minimal.

schemaVersion.description: Incremented whenever a field changes meaning. 2 = base shadow atoms + mode-independent fonts/radius/spacing/tracking + alpha-bearing colours.

fonts.description: Mode-independent family lists. Omitted entirely when the preset names no family; the bundled default then applies.

radius.description: The shadcn --radius value in rem with the unit stripped (0.625rem -> 0.625). Unitless in Dart: px = radius * {4,8,12,16,20,24}. See THEME_DESIGN 5.4.

spacing.description: The shadcn --spacing value in rem with the unit stripped (0.25rem -> 0.25). The generator multiplies by 16 to get the Dart SpacingScale base in logical pixels (0.25 -> 4.0).

tracking.description: Letter spacing in em with the unit stripped. The generator multiplies by 16 to get Flutter letterSpacing in logical pixels.

shadow.description: Base shadow atoms per mode. The eight derived sizes are never stored.

shadowsDerived.description: Provenance of shadow.light/shadow.dark. 'cli' = the tweakcn atoms in shadcn_flutter_cli/lib/registry/shared/theme/preset_theme_data.dart. 'from-legacy' = no atoms existed upstream, so the atoms were recovered from the single legacy shadow entry in lib/registry/themes_preset/<id>.json.

colorToken.description: sRGB colour as #RRGGBB (alpha implicitly FF) or #RRGGBBAA. Uppercase hex, leading # required, 0x prefix rejected. Alpha is preserved verbatim - a shadcn dark --border of oklch(1 0 0 / 10%) is #FFFFFF1A, never #FFFFFF.

colorMap.description: All 32 shadcn colour tokens. Every one is required; there is no derivation step inside a preset file.

fonts.description: CSS font-family lists. The first family becomes TextStyle.fontFamily, the remainder fontFamilyFallback.

tracking.description: --tracking-normal plus the optional tight/wide steps. No preset sets tight or wide yet.

shadowAtoms.description: The six tweakcn/shadcn v4 base atoms. ShadowScale.derive multiplies color alpha by opacity, then applies per-size multipliers, so a colour that already carries alpha stays correct.

opacity.description: Base alpha in 0..1. Multiplied with the colour's own alpha.
